item.title: Join two sources
item.description:
Task: you have a CRM export (customers) and an ERP export (prices and stock), and want one table with both.

  1. On Data, check both sources.
  2. A join row appears for the second source. Pick the join type (LEFT to keep every CRM row even without an ERP match is usually the right default) and the matching field on each side (e.g. customer_id ↔ client_ref).
  3. Check the fields you want from each source.
  4. Open Table — the result has one row per matched (or unmatched, for LEFT/RIGHT/FULL) pair.

(More recipes — conditions, formulas, grouping with aggregates — coming soon.)
